terms_intro: Welcome to Pay Tracker. Please read these terms carefully before using our service.
terms_sec1_desc: By accessing or using Pay Tracker, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you disagree with any part, you may not access our services.
terms_sec2_desc: You must provide accurate, complete, and current information when creating an account. You are responsible for safeguarding your account password and security.
terms_sec3_desc: All billing payments are governed by our transaction terms. We facilitate invoice generation and payment tracking, but transactions are settled through authorized UPI/payment channels.
terms_sec4_desc: Pay Tracker shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages resulting from your use of or inability to use our platform.
privacy_intro: Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your personal information.
privacy_sec1_desc: We collect information you provide directly, such as your business name, email address, payment details, client information, and invoice records.
privacy_sec2_desc: We use the collected information to generate invoices, track payment status, send notifications, prevent fraud, and improve our services.
privacy_sec3_desc: We implement industry-standard 256-bit encryption and security measures to protect your personal and financial data against unauthorized access.
privacy_sec4_desc: We do not sell your personal data. We only share information with payment gateways (like Razorpay) necessary to process your transactions.
support_subtitle: Need help? We're here to support your cash flow journey.
support_faq_q1: How long do UPI payments take to reflect?
support_faq_a1: UPI payments are processed instantly and usually reflect on Pay Tracker within seconds. In case of network delays, it may take up to 10 minutes.
support_faq_q2: How can I download a PDF invoice?
support_faq_a2: You can download any invoice by clicking the 'Download PDF' button on the invoice details or payment page.
support_faq_q3: What should I do if a payment failed?
support_faq_a3: If a payment failed but money was deducted, our payment gateway partner (Razorpay) will automatically initiate a refund to the original payment source within 4-5 business days.
support_faq_a4: Yes, recurring invoicing is available for Premium users. You can enable it in the Invoice creation settings.
support_contact_desc: Can't find the answer you need? Send us a message and our support team will get back to you within 24 hours.
support_contact_success: Thank you! Your message has been sent to our support team.
